findings.studentUsefulness: Budget by active membership duration and course assessment workload; verify destination acceptance before paying.
findings.novelty: Reverified older information; not a new policy change.

costs.tax: Applicable tax excluded; computed at checkout.
costs.assumptions: Membership duration determines total cost; do not quote a fixed $99 per course. Unfinished work may require another renewal. Annual pricing remains unresolved: public pricing advertises $799 while the currently readable official billing tutorial says $599; retain existing conflict warning and verify checkout.

assessment.identity: TypingDNA; SMS alternative after unsuccessful typing attempts; possible Jumio government-issued ID/selfie verification.
assessment.exceptions: Some courses include expert-graded written or project Touchstones; science lab courses may use Labster activities. No no-assignment claim is supported.
assessment.passing: Pricing page requires all Challenge questions attempted, final Milestone completed, and overall 70% average across assessment categories if applicable.

findings.implementation: Preserve current dist/data/credit-sources.json annual price conflict note, which this fresh check independently confirms. Refresh evidence date if publishing; retain no-proctor with identity/workload caveats. Existing matching assessment metadata needs no semantic change.

findings.studentUsefulness: Compare library eligibility and concurrent course limits rather than outdated exam caps.
findings.novelty: Reverified current plans; effective price-change date not established.

costs.assumptions: Unlimited monthly completions and included exam attempts apply to current College Saver/Pro policies. Do not apply obsolete two-exam/$70-extra-exam model.

assessment.identity: Before each final: TypingDNA or Veriff government-issued ID/selfie verification. A camera-enabled device may be needed. Finals require desktop/laptop.
assessment.exceptions: Final policy says all finals; individual courses may also include projects requiring manual grading. No course with a proctoring exception was established in current official policy.
assessment.timing: Exam results usually same day; project work or abnormalities may delay final course result.

findings.implementation: Use current plan names and monthly completion limits. Existing assessment metadata agrees; check calculators for outdated exam caps before changing canonical pricing.

findings.studentUsefulness: A very low-cost credit exam still requires proctoring and a valid ACE window.

costs.scope: Required SmarterProctoring is described for most ACE Recommended Credit courses. Do not universalize without course verification.
costs.assumptions: $5 is per exam proctoring session/attempt. Retakes increase cost.

assessment.creditRequirement: Pass the separate ACE Recommended Credit / Saylor Direct Credit Final Exam. Certificate exam does not confer ACE recommendation.
assessment.allowedAll: Blank paper, pen/pencil, physical or on-screen calculator.

courseMaterialExceptions.PHYS102: Physics formulas sheet and basic integrals table

assessment.limits: Specific exceptions to $5 'most' qualifier were not identified. Live credit course list returned no readable lines; don't infer full current available inventory.

findings.implementation: Keep provider out of no-proctor classifications. Preserve any already-earned historically valid course credit when availability windows end.

findings.studentUsefulness: Credit is university-issued; distinguish $25 course access from full $425 transcripted credit cost.
findings.novelty: Reverified older pricing; no effective price-change date established.

costs.creditDecisionWindow: Up to one year after becoming eligible, per ULC pricing page
costs.applicationFee: Separate if applying to ASU; amount not established here.
costs.assumptions: $425 is successful course enrollment plus optional transcript posting. Retakes or a separate ASU application can add costs.

findings.transcript: Official ASU credit after successful completion and conversion payment; course pages state it appears identically to enrolled-ASU coursework, with attendance/completion session dates.
findings.eligibility: Admitted degree-seeking ASU students cannot register; FAQ describes possible eligibility after deferral or seven terms without active enrollment. Academic disqualification restrictions apply. Identity verified before the course with live photo and approved ID.
findings.minimumCreditPostingTime: FAQ: on-demand 3/4-credit courses post no sooner than 6 weeks after enrollment; 2-credit courses after 4 weeks and 1-credit courses after 2 weeks. On-demand coursework has a one-year completion window.

assessment.providerDefault: Course-specific: ASU says some courses proctor exams/quizzes using software monitoring webcam and screen; instructor syllabus controls.

ENG101.notVerified: Current complete grading and explicit no-proctor claim. Published syllabus PDF retrieval failed with tool-reported 500; no assertion of absent exams.

CAP150.notVerified: Complete grade weighting and explicit no-proctor claim. Official syllabus linked at SimpleSyllabus j9xz9vm8t returned zero readable lines.

findings.implementation: Price may be refreshed if stale; do not publish ENG101/CAP150 as verified proctor-free or change course assessment flags until current syllabus can be read.
